live.offline: The editor is disconnected. Content is read-only until the connection returns, then changes merge automatically.
live.authFailed: The editor could not be opened. Reload the page.
live.saveError: The latest changes could not be saved: {{reason}}

saveErrors.rows_invalid: The document's structure is inconsistent. Reload the page, and contact support if it happens again. Submission is blocked until this is resolved.
saveErrors.node_too_deep: A node is deeper than the structure template's levels. Move it up a level; submission is blocked until then.
saveErrors.node_title_invalid: A node's title is empty or longer than 500 characters. Correct it; submission is blocked until then.
saveErrors.block_content_invalid: A block contains something that is not allowed, such as an unsafe link. Correct it; submission is blocked until then.
saveErrors.document_invalid: The document could not be turned into rows. Reload the page, and contact support if it happens again. Submission is blocked until this is resolved.
saveErrors.document_too_large: The document is larger than the server accepts. Split the content or remove large parts of it.
saveErrors.save_unavailable: The server cannot be reached right now. Your changes stay in the editor and saving is retried automatically.
saveErrors.save_refused: The server refused the save. Reload the page, and contact support if it happens again.

live.locked: This version was submitted or cancelled and can no longer be edited. Reload the page to see its state.
live.frozen: Someone is submitting this version, so editing is paused. If the submission does not go through, editing resumes on its own.
live.submitWaits: Submission becomes available once all your changes have reached the server.
